llm_response.reason: The website uses the name of a well-known artist (Francoise Mouret) unrelated to work boots to sell Caterpillar-branded products, indicating an attempt to spoof a legitimate company (scam indicator #16). The site displays psychological tactics (e.g., 'Hot Sale', 'Free Shipping', '100% Secure Shopping'), lacks functional e-commerce links, and omits real business contact information (scam indicators #1, #3, #6, #7, #13). The product listings and branding attempt to mimic Cat Footwear's genuine site but have no legitimate connection, and there is no evidence of rightful authorization or transparency. These all strongly suggest a fake online shopping scam.
